subject: Problem with extensions in DT package

messages.author: 79c258677787696c
messages.subject: Problem with extensions in DT package
parts:
Hi to all,
I want to use the extensions ColVis and ColReorder from the package DT.
I have done it for a previous shinyapp like this
 
    
output$tbl <-DT::renderDataTable({
     
         DT::datatable(resultsDT,rownames = FALSE,filter = 'bottom',
  extensions =c('ColVis','ColReorder'),  list(dom = 'RC<"clear">lfrtip',colVis=list(exclude=c(0,1))))
       })

and I had no problem whatsoever.
I am trying to do the same thing but it doesn't work. I get the error
 The extension colVisdoes not exist
I have tried to use different extensions and I have the same problem.
Is it related to the versions that I have installed or is it sth else?
